name: Loom Spider
notes: Loom Spiders (story bible §8, style bible §5.2): pale, dog-sized, legs wider than the body. Agent 0.5 m radius (leg span), 0.6 m tall. On the ground: sneak 1.0, walk 2.0, run 6.0 m/s, 0.5 m steps, 60° slopes, 1.5 m pounces, 4 m drops. They wallcrawl up any wall and across ceilings (0.8–4.0 m/s), whatever its climbing grade, so they drop on the player from above and a climbing thief is never out of reach. They barely wade (0.3 m), cannot swim, cannot open doors and are too wide for crawlspaces. Fear of light is a behaviour (e12.10), not locomotion.
